Looking For More Information? .Find answers to all your questions about Encompass Consumer Connect and its features. What is Encompass Consumer Connect? The Encompass Consumer connect is an online portal through which borrowers can make applications, post necessary documents as well as monitor the progress of their loans online. It is built as part of the Consumer Connect mortgage platform, and is intended to improve the overall borrower experience and assist lenders with effective solutions to Encompass lenders. How does Encompass Consumer Connect benefit borrowers? Encompass Consumer Connect improves the borrower experience with an easy-to-use, mobile-friendly digital mortgage application portal that streamlines all the steps involved in taking a loan. Borrowers are given the opportunity to fill the application fast, safely send the necessary documents, review disclosures, and monitor their progress in real time. Through professional Encompass Consumer Connection Implementation, lenders have the opportunity to decrease friction and accelerate data collection and provide a borrowing experience that seems modern, transparent, and highly guided. How does Consumer Connect integrate with Encompass LOS? With effective Encompass Consumer Connect integration, all borrower details, documents and application data are directly transferred into the Encompass LOS in real-time. This will eradicate data duplication, and files will be availed instantaneously to the processing teams. Together with enhanced Encompass solutions for lenders, Consumer Connect builds a single workflow in which the data of loans is automatically synchronized, checked, and directed automatically for faster decisioning. Can Consumer Connect verify borrower assets and income automatically? Yes. The Consumer Connect mortgage platform will be connected with third-party verification services that can be trusted by automatically verifying the assets, income, and employment of the borrower. This minimizes the necessity of manual documentation, reduces the underwriting times, and enhances its accuracy. This gives the lenders quicker approvals and an easier process which is facilitated by automated verification tools. Is the Consumer Connect application flow customizable for lenders? Absolutely. Lenders have the ability to customize almost every step of the application process with flexible Encompass Consumer Connect customization and deep Encompass LOS customization. These involve the manipulation of fields, disclosure settings, branding, workflow logic and page layouts. A properly designed Encompass Consumer Connect system will make sure that the journey of a borrower will fit exactly into the operational requirements of each lender. Does it support “save and exit” during the application? Yes. The application process can be suspended at any point by the borrower and can later be resumed using secure encompass consumer connect login credentials. This feature is useful in minimizing application abandonment since the borrower is in control of completing his tasks at his own time, particularly when he is compiling his financial documents or other information. Can borrowers upload documents, and where do they go? Borrowers can simply post documents like pay stubs, IDs or bank statements directly within the electronic mortgage application system. The seamless Encompass Consumer Connect integration immediately transfers these files into the appropriate loan file folders so they are immediately available to processors, underwriters and compliance teams without any manual intervention. What security or identity verification does Consumer Connect provide? Encompass Consumer Connect secures the sensitive borrower data through multi-factor authentication, encrypted logins, and secure communication measures. Identity verification tools assist the lenders to keep the compliance intact and have the applicants properly authenticated to provide a secure and reliable setting in digital loan submissions.
